glossary.definition: For purposes of this section, "debt charges" and "securities" have the same meanings as in section 133.01 of the Revised Code, and "board of health of a general health district" includes a board of health of a combined health district formed pursuant to section 3709.07 , 3709.071 , or 3709.10 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: board of health of a general health district
